summary.text: Ismael Luna is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Angel Sanchez. A case manager at a homeless shelter, he lists housing, healthcare and immigrant rights as his top issues.

paragraphs.text: Ismael Luna graduated from Riverside University High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Cardinal Stritch University in 2022 and a graduate degree from George Washington University in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on Milwaukee's South Side in a working-class immigrant family, was homeless at 14, and works as a case manager at a homeless shelter helping women find stable housing.
He said he previously served as vice chair of RISE Drug Free MKE and has been involved in community organizing since high school.
Luna advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.

He said he would work to expand affordable housing, expand BadgerCare and support a public option, lower prescription drug and utility costs, fully fund schools, and keep immigration enforcement out of Milwaukee.
